title: Five-target server UI build and manifest contract
scope: Node 22 source builds for member, member-auth, admin, admin-pilot, and ops-glance
staged SPA output inventory and file-integrity manifest
native installer and Docker build integration
runtime Python manifest validation without Flask or Node
owner_decision: Build all five SPAs from source with Node 22

manifest_fields: per-file path, SHA-256, and byte size
implementation.promotion: Build into a clean staging directory; validate five exact inventories and hashes before promotion; restore the prior dist directory if stage promotion fails

verification.manifest_source_commit_note: The local Docker verification did not pass ONEIRODEX_BUILD_SHA and the build context excludes .git. CI may provide the commit through the build argument.

findings.claim: Native installers and Docker build all required entry surfaces from source using Node 22.
findings.evidence: Pinned Node 22 Docker frontend build completed all five targets; focused installer and Docker contract tests passed.

findings.claim: Incomplete, stale, or altered asset output cannot be promoted as a valid generation.
findings.evidence: Manifest tests reject each missing target, missing and digest-mismatched files, unlisted stale files, and lockfile mismatch; promotion failure restores the prior generation.

findings.claim: Native installer completion and cross-platform install/upgrade behavior are qualified.
findings.evidence: The Docker build verifies the shared build contract only. This host has Node 26 on PATH; native installers were not run on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

limits: No clean native install or upgrade journey was run.
No browser render or five-surface runtime smoke was run.
Local verification manifest has no source commit because no build SHA was supplied to Docker.
Vite reported existing large-chunk warnings and runtime theme CSS paths that are expected to resolve at runtime.
